title: Head of Support
why_this_account: industry fit (SaaS); ~120 employees; buyer title (Head of Support); signal: hiring_support; signal: helpdesk_tool
subject_1: support hiring at northwind example saas
body_1:
Hi Dana,

Saw Northwind Example SaaS is hiring on the support side. Before adding headcount, it can be worth checking how many tickets reach the wrong person first. Tickets that land with the wrong person get reassigned, and each hand-off costs a reply cycle.

I build ticket triage that classifies, prioritises and routes on arrival. I run it on a sample of your last 200 tickets and show you the routing accuracy. No cost, no integration.

Worth a look?

Shabda
subject_2: re: support hiring at northwind example saas
body_2:
Dana, a quick follow up. The sample run takes me about a day and you get the accuracy numbers either way. Should I send over what I would need?
Shabda
subject_3: re: support hiring at northwind example saas
body_3:
Different angle, Dana: if routing is not your bottleneck, the same classifier can tag ticket themes so product gets a weekly view of what customers keep hitting. Useful for Northwind Example SaaS?
Shabda
subject_4: re: support hiring at northwind example saas
body_4:
I will leave it here, Dana. If ticket routing becomes a priority at Northwind Example SaaS, the offer to test on 200 tickets stands.
Shabda

title: VP Customer Success
why_this_account: industry fit (Software); ~140 employees; buyer title (VP Customer Success); signal: helpdesk_tool; signal: recent_funding
subject_1: tickets landing in the wrong queue
body_1:
Hi Omar,

Brightpath Example runs its support desk on Intercom. The routing rules inside those tools tend to handle the obvious cases and miss the rest, so someone ends up reading and reassigning tickets by hand.

I build a triage layer that sits in front of the helpdesk and reads each ticket for category, urgency and the right owner. I run it on a sample of your last 200 tickets and show you the routing accuracy. No cost, no integration.

Open to it?

Shabda
subject_2: re: tickets landing in the wrong queue
body_2:
Omar, following up in case this got buried. I only need a CSV export of recent tickets to run the test. Want me to send the exact columns?
Shabda
subject_3: re: tickets landing in the wrong queue
body_3:
One more thought, Omar. Urgent tickets that sit in a general queue are the ones that turn into escalations. The pilot reports how many of yours would have been flagged earlier.
Shabda
subject_4: re: tickets landing in the wrong queue
body_4:
Closing the loop, Omar. If this is not a fit for Brightpath Example right now, no problem at all.
Shabda
